_comment: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge, Kaggle Stage 2 files. Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Sources: the Kaggle data page (26,684 train images, 3,000 stage 2 test images), and the raw files read with pandas and pydicom (stage_2_detailed_class_info.csv, stage_2_train_labels.csv, the DICOM headers). Both CSVs have one line per box, and one line for each image with no box (9,555 + 20,672 = 30,227 lines). Each patientId has one class and one Target, so the table has one row per image (D-03). The patientId is the file name and the DICOM PatientID, so patients = studies = images. Sex and age are only in the DICOM headers. 5 train ages and 1 test age are over 100 (148 to 412), probably data errors. The age rule of radharmony/harmonizer/_age.py gives NaN for an age above 130, so age_years has no such value (D-06). The test images have no labels (D-25).
